$comment: OpenClaw agent manifest for 'Nara on NemoClaw' (β groundwork; 2-tool slice, 2026-06-09, Limb L2). This is a STATIC config file; applying it to the live sandbox is integrator/human work (see docs/nemoclaw_agent_run_runbook.md). The bundle now grants TWO tools: get_apparatus_state (read-only) and run_loop_iteration (the ONE write-capable tool — it triggers EXACTLY ONE bounded host iteration: hypothesize->retrieve->novelty->critic->journal, and nothing else). The security boundary on that one write is THREE-fold and all server-side: (1) the host validates the topic and trips a low-evidence gate on off-domain/thin topics; (2) one-iteration-at-a-time is enforced host-side; (3) the egress preset nara-host-tool-plane scopes the agent's reach to host.openshell.internal:8077 only. Capability-ABSENCE still holds for everything dangerous: NO spawn / write-to-repo / commit / trade tool is granted, so the agent physically cannot do those (per the 2026-06-09 autonomy-boundary finding — absence, not a downstream schema check).

harness.$comment_harness: FACT-CORRECTED 2026-06-09 (Limb L2 probe of nemoclaw v0.0.55): the OpenClaw stack has NO 'claude-cli' agent runtime — the only installed agent runtimes are 'openclaw' (default) and 'hermes' (agents/*/manifest.yaml). The earlier 'avoid the claude-cli default' framing was wrong about this version. D-013 (local harness) / D-014 (never authenticate to Claude) are satisfied by: agent runtime = OpenClaw, INFERENCE provider = the sandbox's already-configured vllm-local/gemma-4-26b-a4b (status shows 'Agent: OpenClaw v2026.5.18', 'Provider: vllm-local', 'Inference (vllm backend): healthy'). The trap to avoid is `openclaw agent --local`, which 'requires model provider API keys in your shell' (the Claude/Anthropic path); the GATEWAY-routed `openclaw agent` (no --local) uses the sandbox's vllm-local route. So: runtime=openclaw, provider=local Gemma, NEVER --local, NEVER an Anthropic key.
harness.$comment_provider: Mirrors the sandbox's existing inference binding (D-031): provider 'vllm-local', model 'gemma-4-26b-a4b', routed through the host gateway to the host vLLM :8000. This is the SAME single model the apparatus uses (D-033 single-model); the bundle introduces no second model.

$comment_allow_list: The closed action menu IS the allow-list (the γ permission-preset mechanism, arriving early at β). TWO tools: one read-only (get_apparatus_state) + one write-capable (run_loop_iteration — triggers exactly one bounded iteration). The MUST-NOTs are enforced by capability ABSENCE: no write-to-repo/spawn/commit/trade tool is in this list or in tools.json, so the agent cannot do those at all.
